Residency is an axis, not a role. The installed harness and a users server-side agent are BOTH sub-director, differing by scope. Encoding residency in role names is what produced local-director, local-subdirector, subdirector and director+director_tier=sub.

INCIDENT: two commit attempts in the shared checkout drove lint-staged to stash and fail to restore. git status fell 43 modified -> 1, staged -> 0, and 51 files of concurrent agent work (pipeline.ts, slashCommands.ts, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml) were stranded in stash@{0}. All 51 recovered byte-identical. Commit from a worktree, never the shared checkout while the fleet runs.

Corrected an over-broad claim of my own: the standard originally barred dacc_role/idNumber/NFT outright. That described their current implementations, not the concepts. Each has a reintegration path - NFT as a wallet TrustRootKind anchoring a DID (the signature primitives already exist in BlockchainService; only a nonce challenge and an ownerOf check are missing), idNumber as a registry alias resolving to a did:tnf, dacc_role as registry-assigned classification for routing. The absolute rule is narrower: ownership is proven, never asserted.

Reintegrate NFT/wallet identity as a TRUST ROOT, not a competing identifier: add `wallet` to TrustRootKind and implement TrustRootProvider over packages/relay-core/src/services/shared/BlockchainService.ts. verifyMessage(message,signature)->recoveredAddress and getAgentNFTContract() already exist; what is missing is a nonce challenge and an ownerOf(tokenId)===recoveredAddress check. A wallet-backed DID (did:pkh / did:ethr) anchors a did:tnf rather than replacing it, and gives TNF external verifiability without being its own trust root - which is what federation across orgs and the agent marketplace need. The 2026-08-25 P0 was a template-literal "signature", not a verdict on NFT identity. Wire it against a broker someone is watching.

Reintegrate idNumber as an ALIAS: register idNumber -> did:tnf in the operator registry so ID#:<Base58> becomes a resolvable human-facing index (wiki attribution, reputation continuity, stable across key rotation) that grants nothing on its own. Its symmetric-HMAC weakness stops mattering once nothing treats it as evidence.

Reintegrate dacc_role as trustworthy CLASSIFICATION: assign it in the registry or agent frontmatter instead of deriveDaccRole()'s filename substring match. It then serves capability discovery, routing and agent matching - the lane where loose matching is correct. Keep it classification; promoting it to authority would create a second vocabulary for one fact.

It is NOT in this monorepo - there is no apps/ai-arcade, only docs/ai-arcade/, four audits, apps/api/ARCADE_CHAIN_LISTENER.md and a Cloud Run env sync script. Merging means reconciling across two repos.

MARKETPLACE HONESTY: three unrelated systems are called "marketplace". (1) marketplace_listings is an order book for fractional agent-NFT shares - keyed on agentNFTId with shareAmount/pricePerShare, structurally unable to represent an image, track, skill or workflow. (2) marketplace.service.ts is a research/discovery catalog (getResearchCounts, searchResearchPrompts, getResearchSkillSources) with no price, checkout or ownership. (3) the ai_assets_marketplace pgSchema is a crawler feeding (2). What ships as "the marketplace" is largely crawled third-party assets presented as offerings. A real listings model is needed carrying item type (skill|workflow|image|music|agent-share), seller, price, media, provenance and licence; the equity order book becomes one item type rather than the whole model.

MARKETPLACE CONTRACTS: packages/contracts-legacy holds 10 tracked .sol files that are the marketplace foundation - RoyaltySplitter (commissions), FractionalizationVault (fractional ownership), RentalMarketplace, FuseAuctionManager, AgentProvenance, FuseBadges (candidate TNF-NFT listing gate), AgentSponsorshipSFT, FuseRevenueRouter, AgentNFTFactory, FuseAgencyRegistry. Shelved by commit 68287ea4b for priority reasons, NOT superseded (operator confirmed 2026-09-03). Meanwhile packages/contracts/src holds the deployed arcade game economy (GenesisNode, MerkabaCore, SidepotManager, AuctionEngine, PTPrizeHookRouter) on Base Sepolia. Unshelve contracts-legacy rather than rewriting it.
